detailed_descriptions.en: Swarmslam is an idle incremental game about a swarm that smashes planets, cracks their core and moves on. You don't control them, you just give them directions, give them more power and watch ore fly left and right. Gather more power by cracking planets over and over again, invest ore to get otherworldly powers and become stronger, more efficient, until you satisfy THE VOID. Lots of planets, lots of ore, sinks, skill tree, ...COREBREAK prestige, ...even trading?.. and more. SLAM. CRACK. REPEAT.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Swarmslam is an idle incremental game about a swarm that smashes planets, cracks their core and moves on.

You don't control them, you just give them directions, give them more power and watch ore fly left and right.

Gather more power by cracking planets over and over again, invest ore to get otherworldly powers and become stronger, more efficient, until you satisfy THE VOID.

Lots of planets, lots of ore, sinks, skill tree, ...COREBREAK prestige, ...even trading?.. and more.

SLAM. CRACK. REPEAT.
